body.p: Once an old burbot gathered its relatives in a big lake. The old burbot told its relatives: "I will tell the fox, when it comes: "Hey, man, let's run a race"." The burbot sent its relatives to different river reaches. When the rivers began to freeze up, the fox went on the ice. Going it suddenly saw the burbot, which was lying under the water on the ground. The fox said to the burbot: "Hey, man, let's run a race!" The burbot said: "Well, if you can stand it, run a race with me." The fox and the burbot started to run a race. Gallopping the fox shouted to its friend: "Burbot!" "Hey", its friend responded. At the next river reach, passing its own river reach, it [=the fox] shouts to its friend, choking. Its friend responds from before. The fox said: "How quick, how quick!" It reached the third river reach, being about to choke. At this river reach, where it had come, another burbot was waiting. The burbot is asked by the fox: "How are you so fast?" The burbot said: "If you don't stand it, don't wish to run a race with me." So the fox went off and said: "From now on, I don't want to run a race with you anymore." The burbots gathered and started to laugh about the fox: "It ran a race with us for nothing."
